            <p data-dc-tpl="125" style="margin: 0px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.65; color: rgb(78, 63, 50);"><span class="sc-interp">Morning swim. Barefoot walk. A long afternoon in the shallows. Then do it all again at sunset.</span></p>
          </div>

            <p data-dc-tpl="125" style="margin: 0px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.65; color: rgb(78, 63, 50);"><span class="sc-interp">Swim first. Paddle later. Stay barefoot as long as possible.</span></p>
          </div>
